author: XUNY
quote: The soul’s gone. This isn’t GTA at all. Why all the blind praise? Dan Houser’s writing is what gave GTA its soul. Without a solid story, the gameplay itself is nothing special. It can’t keep players engaged for long. Back in the day, people only thought mindlessly killing NPCs and fighting cops was fun because they hadn’t seen much else. And as for chasing photorealistic graphics—there are so many alternatives for that. Aren’t movies realistic? Isn’t traveling in real life realistic? What’s so realistic about 30 frames per second?
